ladder.label: NEARING A LOW
ladder.why: Day 29 of a typical 36-42-day cycle — inside the window where lows usually form, and short-term momentum is washed out. No confirmed turn yet. Last cycle was left-translated (topped early) — a bearish structural tell.
ladder.next: Wait for the turn: a move above the low candle's high, then a close back above the 10-day average.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; last cycle left-translated (topped early)
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; last cycle left-translated (topped early) (investor cycle week 10 · daily cycle day 29).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a low. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity contracting — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)

entry.text: A cycle low is due in roughly ~7–13 trading days — watch for the turn, don't front-run it.
entry.text_zh: 周期低点预计在约 ~7–13 个交易日内出现——等待转向，切勿抢跑。

cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its FIRST half ('left-translated') — weak cycles top early, so this hints the bigger trend is tiring.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在前半段见顶（“左移”）——弱周期见顶偏早，这暗示更大的趋势正在走弱。

ladder.why_zh: 典型 36-42 天周期的第 29 天——处于低点通常形成的窗口内，且短期动量已被洗净。尚无确认的转向。 上一周期为左移结构（见顶偏早）——属于看空的结构性信号。
ladder.next_zh: 等待转向：先上破低点 K 线的高点，再收盘重新站上 10 日均线。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：混合 — 周线动量为正；但正趋向周线向下交叉；上一周期左移（见顶偏早）（投资者周期第 10 周 · 日线周期第 29 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：接近低点。大局（趋势不明）：混合。
points_zh: 大局为混合（对日线多头而言属趋势不明）
宏观：美国净流动性收缩——对概率属需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
仍位于 10 日均线之下
上一周期见顶偏早（趋势走弱的暗示）
ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 宏观逆风：美国净流动性正在收缩——在此环境下买入形态历史上胜率更低、回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是概率优势，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ NEARING A LOW signal just triggered today (fresh cross from BOTTOMING). Signal strength: faint (score +0/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 接近低点信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自筑底中翻转）。 信号强度：微弱（评分 +0/100）。
ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: solid buy setting up (+35)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健买入构筑中（+35）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✗ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 —
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

profile.description: H&R Block, Inc., or H&R Block, is an American tax preparation company operating in Canada, the United States, and Australia. The company was founded in 1955 in Kansas City, Missouri, by brothers Henry W.
profile.description_zh: H&R Block, Inc.（简称H&R Block）是一家美国税务申报公司，业务覆盖加拿大、美国和澳大利亚。该公司由亨利·W兄弟于1955年在密苏里州堪萨斯城创立。
